name: BMN 351
sort_evidence: BMN 351 is an exon-51 oligonucleotide for Duchenne with Phase 1/2 NCT06280209 active and extension NCT07573631 enrolling, and BioMarin's Q2 2026 report guides a year-end 2026 update (https://www.biomarin.com/news/press-releases/biomarin-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-and-operating-results/).

trials.title: An Open-Label Extension Study to Evaluate the Long-term Safety and Efficacy of BMN 351 in Participants With Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy
A Phase 1/2 Study to Assess the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, and Pharmacodynamics of BMN 351 in Participants With Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy
